summary: Markets closed Friday at fresh record highs after a surprisingly weak July jobs report removed immediate pressure for Fed rate hikes. The S&P 500 advanced 0.62% to close at 7,757.64, while the Nasdaq Composite surged 1.3% to 26,690.62, posting its best week since April with a 5.2% gain. The Bureau of Labor Statistics reported a shocking 23,000 job losses in July versus expectations for 80,000 additions, pushing unemployment down to 4.1% and convincing markets the Fed will keep rates on hold at least through September. Money markets have pushed the next potential rate hike out to December. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh held rates steady at the July meeting in his first decision, though three FOMC members dissented and favored a hike. Bitcoin and Ethereum rallied on the dovish macro backdrop, with BTC climbing above $65,000 and ETH approaching $1,930. Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs posted fresh inflows on August 7, while XRP ETFs logged their second zero-activity day of the month despite spot XRP trading up 1.26% at $1.03.

signals.title: July jobs report shows unexpected 23,000 job losses
signals.desc: The miss versus 80,000 expected gains removes pressure for Fed rate hikes and pushed stocks to record highs as money markets delay hike bets to December.

signals.title: Three FOMC members dissented at July meeting seeking rate hike
signals.desc: Despite Chair Warsh holding rates at 3.5%-3.75%, the 9-3 vote reveals hawkish undercurrent that could limit dovish policy pivot.

signals.title: Bitcoin and Ethereum ETFs post fresh inflows on August 7
signals.desc: Ethereum extended its four-day inflow streak while Bitcoin flows remained positive, signaling sustained institutional demand despite recent consolidation.

signals.title: Encompass Health beats Q2 estimates and raises guidance
signals.desc: The healthcare company delivered $1.6 billion revenue and $1.55 EPS, topping forecasts and lifting 2026 outlook, with shares up 12.75% over the week.

signals.title: SpaceX lockup expiry passes without major selloff
signals.desc: Over 900 million shares became eligible for sale on August 6 as early investor lockups expired, but stock rallied 14% as fears faded.

verdict: With the Fed on hold, stocks at records, and crypto inflows resuming, risk appetite remains strong into next week despite lingering FOMC dissent.
